missions.title: Shift Start
missions.subtitle: Pre-shift checks and a first look
brief: Report to the training area for your first shift.
Do the walk-around, start the machine, and drive the apron to check the route.

objectives.label: Sound the horn before moving off

tips: There is no load in this job. Get the route into your head: gate → yard → warehouse → quay.

missions.title: Pallet Shuffle
missions.subtitle: Truck to warehouse
brief: An inbound trailer at gate lane 1 is carrying mixed pallets.
Take one pallet from the trailer and place it at the warehouse dock.

objectives.label: Deliver it to the warehouse dock

tips: Watch the pedestrian walkway on the south road.

missions.title: Yard Transfer
missions.subtitle: Two containers into Block E1
brief: Two 20 ft boxes are loose on the south apron.
Stack both of them in Block E1. Use the first row, ground tier.
tips: Line up with the block lane first, then extend the boom — never the other way round.

missions.title: Housekeeping
missions.subtitle: Re-stack a messy row
brief: Block S2 has been left in a mess by the previous shift — boxes at mixed heights.
Bring the block back to a clean two-high profile.

objectives.label: Leave 2 containers stacked in Block S2

tips: Only the top box of a column can be lifted. Plan the order before you start.

missions.title: Quay Delivery
missions.subtitle: Yard to ship's side
brief: The ship-to-shore gantry has discharged a run of boxes onto the apron.
Move one of them back into the yard so the quay stays clear.

objectives.label: Lift a container from the quay

tips: The striped band along the quay is a working zone. Keep your machine out of it unless you are picking up or setting down.

missions.title: Retrieve the Box
missions.subtitle: Find one specific container
brief: A customer needs one specific unit out of Block N1.
Check the job card for the ID, dig it out and take it to the gate.

objectives.label: Retrieve the nominated container from Block N1

tips: The nominated container is the one marked with a gold marker. Anything on top of it must come off first.

missions.title: Gantry Shift
missions.subtitle: Work the block with the RTG
brief: Take the gantry crane over Block N1 for a shift.
Pull two boxes out of the stack and set them on the transfer lane.

objectives.label: Lift 2 containers out of Block N1
Set both down on the transfer lane

tips: Travel first, trolley second, hoist last. Three axes, one at a time.

missions.title: Heavy Lift
missions.subtitle: Out-of-gauge cargo at the berth
brief: An out-of-gauge unit has arrived on the quay and the ship cannot take it by gantry.
Use the mobile harbour crane — mind the radius chart.
tips: Lift close in, travel, then set down. Never travel with the boom extended far out.

missions.title: Full Terminal Operation
missions.subtitle: Everything at once
brief: Peak shift. The gantry is landing boxes on the apron and the yard is filling up.
Clear the quay into the yard, then load the outbound trailer at the gate.

objectives.label: Load the outbound trailer in lane 4

tips: Plan every journey. An empty run across the terminal is wasted time and wasted score.

freeJobs.title: Move a box
freeJobs.text: Take one container from the apron into a free yard slot.

freeJobs.title: Pallet run
freeJobs.text: Deliver a pallet to the warehouse dock.

freeJobs.title: Gate loading
freeJobs.text: Load a container onto the outbound trailer in lane 3.

freeJobs.title: Block shuffle
freeJobs.text: Re-stack two containers inside one yard block.

freeJobs.title: Keep the quay clear
freeJobs.text: Move a box off the quay apron into the yard.

freeJobs.title: Heavy hook
freeJobs.text: Use the harbour crane to place a unit at the warehouse dock.

achievements.name: Clean Sweep
achievements.desc: Complete five missions with no safety events.

achievements.name: Gold Standard
achievements.desc: Earn a gold medal on any mission.

achievements.name: Smooth Operator
achievements.desc: Finish a mission with 100% equipment use.

achievements.name: Regular Hand
achievements.desc: Complete 5 job board tasks in Free Operations.
